title: Quercetin, a key active ingredient of Jianpi Zishen Xiehuo Formula, suppresses M1 macrophage polarization and platelet phagocytosis by inhibiting STAT3 activation based on network pharmacology.
authors: Wang, Wei; Xu, Xuewen; Xu, Yang; Zhan, Yueping; Wu, Chuanyong; Xiao, Xiao; Cheng, Cheng; Gao, Chunfang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究槲皮素通过抑制STAT3信号通路调节巨噬细胞极化和血小板吞噬，属于免疫药理学与疾病机制研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Primary immune thrombocytopenia (ITP) is an autoimmune hemorrhagic disease, and abnormal M1 macrophage polarization participates in the pathogenesis of ITP. Jianpi Zishen Xiehuo (JZX) Formula has a good therapeutic effect on ITP. However, its key active ingredients and molecular mechanisms remain unclear. In this study, we explored the key active ingredients and potential targets of JZX in treating ITP using network pharmacology combined with in vitro experimental verification. A total of 157 active ingredients of JZX were identified from public databases, and quercetin was the most important one. One hundred sixty-five intersection targets of active ingredients in JZX, ITP, and macrophage polarization were obtained by Venn diagram. The top three potential targets were signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3), protein kinase B (PKB/AKT) 1, and c-JUN through protein-protein interaction analysis. Molecular docking showed that quercetin had strong binding affinities with them all. In vitro experiment, CD16(+) monocytes increased in ITP patients compared with healthy controls, which indicated a M1/M2 polarization imbalance in ITP. The expression levels of M1 polarization markers, CD86, CD80, and inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS), M1 polarization-associated cytokines, tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), and interleukin-6 (IL-6), and antibody-opsonized platelet phagocytosis significantly increased in THP-1 macrophages stimulated with lipopolysaccharide (LPS). Quercetin markedly inhibited the expressions of M1 markers, decreased the levels of TNF-alpha and IL-6, and down-regulated the phosphorylated STAT3 (p-STAT3) protein, which confirmed the prediction by network pharmacology and molecular docking. Importantly, quercetin significantly reduced the phagocytosis of antibody opsonised platelet. In conclusion, quercetin suppressed platelet phagocytosis in M1 macrophages via its anti-inflammatory effects and may serve as a potential drug for the treatment of ITP. Quercetin could be a key ingredient for JZX against ITP.
abstract_zh: 原发性免疫性血小板减少症（ITP）是一种自身免疫性出血性疾病，M1巨噬细胞极化异常参与ITP的发病机制。健脾滋肾泻火（JZX）方对ITP具有良好的治疗作用，但其关键活性成分及分子机制尚不清楚。本研究通过网络药理学结合体外实验验证，探讨了JZX治疗ITP的关键活性成分及潜在靶点。从公共数据库中鉴定出JZX的157种活性成分，其中槲皮素（quercetin）最为重要。通过维恩图获得JZX活性成分、ITP及巨噬细胞极化之间的165个交集靶点。通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用分析，排名前三的潜在靶点为信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）、蛋白激酶B（PKB/AKT）1和c-JUN。分子对接显示，槲皮素与它们均具有强结合亲和力。体外实验中，与健康对照相比，ITP患者CD16(+)单核细胞增加，表明ITP中存在M1/M2极化失衡。在脂多糖（LPS）刺激的THP-1巨噬细胞中，M1极化标志物CD86、CD80和诱导型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）、M1极化相关细胞因子肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）和白细胞介素-6（IL-6）的表达水平，以及抗体调理的血小板吞噬作用均显著增加。槲皮素显著抑制M1标志物的表达，降低TNF-α和IL-6水平，并下调磷酸化STAT3（p-STAT3）蛋白，这证实了网络药理学和分子对接的预测。重要的是，槲皮素显著减少了抗体调理血小板的吞噬作用。总之，槲皮素通过其抗炎作用抑制M1巨噬细胞中的血小板吞噬，可能作为治疗ITP的潜在药物。槲皮素可能是JZX对抗ITP的关键成分。
